channel.title: Bharat Naukri Alert — Latest Sarkari Updates
channel.description: Scholarships, exams, jobs aur sarkari schemes ke rozana updates with official links.

item.title: ICAR AIEEA PG Round 1 Seat Allotment Result 2026
item.description: The ICAR AIEEA PG 2026 Round 1 seat allotment result was released on October 5, 2026. Candidates can check their allotment status and download the allotment letter via the official counselling portal at icarcounseling.com

item.title: DSSSB Assistant Superintendent Result 2026 Out
item.description: The Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB) has released the Tier-I result for Assistant Superintendent (Post Code 32/25) in Delhi Prisons. A total of 932 candidates have been provisionally shortlisted for the Physical Endurance Test (PET) against 93 vacancies

item.title: UKSSSC Assistant Agriculture Officer and More Post Admit Card 2026
item.description: UKSSSC has released admit cards on October 5, 2026, for Assistant Agriculture Officer, Fodder Assistant, Artist, Cartographer, and Law Assistant posts. The written examination is scheduled for October 11, 2026. Candidates can download their hall tickets from sssc.uk.gov.in

item.title: MPHC Stenographer and Assistant Grade 3 Recruitment 2026
item.description: High Court of Madhya Pradesh is recruiting for 418 posts of Stenographer Grade-II, Grade-III, and Assistant Grade-III (English Knowing) in District and Session Courts across MP. Selection includes Prelims and Main Skill Test

item.title: DRDO RCI Apprentice Recruitment 2026
item.description: DRDO RCI Hyderabad invites applications for 195 Apprentice positions (Graduate, Technician, and Trade) for the year 2027. Selection is based on academic merit and/or interview

item.title: DSSSB Court Recruitment 2026 for JJA, PA, and Other Posts
item.description: DSSSB is recruiting 641 personnel for Delhi District & Sessions Courts and Family Courts for roles including Junior Judicial Assistant (JJA), Personal Assistant, Process Server, and Peon

item.title: IIT Madras Postdoctoral Researcher Recruitment 2026
item.description: Recruitment 2026 for 1 post of Postdoctoral Researcher. Candidates Can Apply Online. The last date to apply online is 19-10-2026. The candidate shall apply online through IIT Madras official website

item.title: IBPS CRP PO/MT-XVI Recruitment 2026
item.description: Common Recruitment Process for selection of personnel for Probationary Officer/ Management Trainee posts in Participating Banks across India

item.title: Delhi Higher Judicial Service (HJS) Mains Exam Admit Card 2026
item.description: Admit card for the Delhi Higher Judicial Service (HJS) Mains Exam 2026. Candidates require a Bachelor Degree in Law (LLB) and 7 years of active practice as an Advocate

item.title: HPSC Agricultural Development Officer Recruitment 2025 Revised Result
item.description: Haryana Public Service Commission (HPSC) has declared the revised result for the recruitment of 785 Agricultural Development Officer (ADO) posts

item.title: Intelligence Bureau IB MTS Final Result 2026
item.description: Final result for the Intelligence Bureau Multi Tasking Staff (MTS) recruitment 2026 for 362 vacancies

item.title: AP LAWCET/PGLCET Phase 1 Seat Allotment Result 2026
item.description: The AP LAWCET and AP PGLCET 2026 Phase 1 seat allotment result is scheduled for release on October 6, 2026. Candidates can check their allotted college and course on the official counselling portal and complete reporting by October 9, 2026

item.title: Karnataka NEET UG 2026 Round 3 Seat Allotment Result
item.description: KEA has released the provisional Round 3 seat allotment result for Karnataka NEET UG 2026 counselling for MBBS and BDS courses. Candidates must complete Choice-4 or seat cancellation by October 5, 2026

item.title: Junior Lab Assistant - Medical Education Provisional Answer Key
item.description: Kerala Public Service Commission has released the provisional answer key and OMR question paper for the post of Junior Lab Assistant in the Medical Education Department (Category Code: 733/2025)

item.title: NIFTEM Project Fellow Recruitment 2026
item.description: National Institute of Food Technology Entrepreneurship and Management (NIFTEM) Recruitment 2026 for 1 post of Project Fellow. Candidates Can Apply Online. The last date to apply online is 20-10-2026

item.title: WBUHS Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026
item.description: Recruitment 2026 for 5 posts of Assistant Professor. Candidates with Post Graduate Can Apply Online. The last date to apply online is 15-10-2026. The candidate shall apply online through WBUHS

item.title: CSAB 2026 Special Counselling Mock Seat Allotment
item.description: The Central Seat Allocation Board has released the mock seat allotment result for CSAB 2026 Special Counselling for NITs, IIITs, and GFTIs. Candidates can review their probable allotment and revise choices before the final locking deadline of August 5, 2026

item.title: RPSC Deputy Jailor Result 2026
item.description: Rajasthan Public Service Commission has declared the final result and merit list for the Deputy Jailor (Jail Department) Competitive Examination 2024. A total of 70 candidates have been selected

item.title: AP Vidyut Assistant Executive Engineer Result 2026
item.description: AP Vidyut has released the results for the Assistant Executive Engineer (AEE) recruitment for Civil, Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical, and Telecom disciplines. The Computer Based Test was held from August 22-29, 2026, with 630 total vacancies. Candidates can download stream-wise score PDFs

item.title: Ordnance Factory Itarsi Diploma Project Engineer Result 2026
item.description: Ordnance Factory Itarsi has released the list of shortlisted candidates for interview for the post of Tenure Based Diploma Project Engineer (Chemical). Candidates can check the official shortlist PDF on ddpdoo.gov.in

item.title: CDAC Project Engineer & Officer Recruitment 2026
item.description: C-DAC invites online applications for 951 contractual positions including Project Engineer, Project Officer, and Project Support Staff across various centers in India

item.title: AIIMS Mangalagiri Faculty Recruitment 2026
item.description: AIIMS Mangalagiri is inviting applications for 2 Associate Professor (Group-A) faculty positions. Candidates with medical qualifications (MBBS/MD/MS/DM/MCh) and relevant experience can apply online

item.title: BECIL AIIMS Rewari Recruitment 2026

item.title: IBPS Recruitment of Class I & II Posts
item.description: IBPS is recruiting for Class I and Class II Officer posts. Eligible candidates can apply online before the deadline.

item.description: UPSSSC has declared the Mains exam result for the recruitment of 708 Forest Guard and Wildlife Guard posts. Shortlisted candidates will proceed to the Physical Standard Test (PST) and Physical Measurement Test (PMT) stage

item.title: CG Vyapam Assistant Teacher Admit Card 2026

item.description: The High Court of Delhi has released the admit cards for the Delhi Higher Judicial Service Mains Examination (Written) 2026, scheduled to be held on 10th and 11th October 2026

item.description: Gauhati High Court has released the admit cards for the written examination for Multi Tasking Staff (MTS) and Chauffeur (Driver) posts in the Law Research Institute

item.description: Kerala PSC has released the probability list P/L NO:27/2026/DOA for the post of Last Grade Servants (Ex-Servicemen Only) (I NCA for HN) in Alappuzha District (Category No. 869/2025) in NCC / Sainik Welfare Department

item.title: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) and Various Scholarship Schemes
item.description: Various central and private scholarship schemes including AICTE Pragati, Saksham, Swanath, and NMMSS are closing on October 31, 2026. Applicants must verify scheme-specific eligibility on the National Scholarship Portal

item.title: Counsellor Psychologist Recruitment
item.description: IIIT Surat is recruiting for 1 Counsellor Psychologist post. Candidates with a Ph.D. in Clinical/Counselling Psychology, Master's, or Bachelor's Degree in Psychology can apply online. The last date to apply is October 20, 2026. Salary is 50,000/- per month

item.title: UP Police Home Guard Final Result 2026
item.description: Final result for the UP Police Home Guard recruitment 2025, which involved 41,424 vacancies for 10th-pass candidates

item.title: Punjab Police Constable Recruitment 2026
item.description: Punjab Police is recruiting 3298 Constables in District and Armed Police Cadres. Candidates must have passed 10+2 and have Matriculation with Punjabi as a subject. Selection involves CBT, PST, and PMT

item.title: CPRI Recruitment 2026
item.description: CPRI Recruitment 2026 is open for 110 vacancies across engineering, scientific, technical and support posts. Check eligibility, application fee, GATE requirements and the last date to apply

item.title: SBI PO Recruitment 2026
item.description: SBI is recruiting 1,500 Probationary Officers across India. Eligible candidates with a graduation degree can apply through the official SBI Careers portal. The registration window closes on July 8, 2026. Application fee is Rs 750 for UR/OBC/EWS, and exempted for SC/ST/PwBD

item.title: CPRI Recruitment 2026 for Engineering, Scientific, Technical and Support Posts
item.description: CPRI is inviting applications for 110 vacancies across engineering, scientific, technical, and support posts

item.title: SBI Clerk Special Recruitment 2026
item.description: State Bank of India is conducting a special recruitment drive to fill 1538 Junior Associate (JA) posts. The registration process concludes on August 27, 2026

item.title: PSSSB Craft Instructor Admit Card 2026 Out
item.description: The PSSSB Craft Instructor Admit Card 2026 has been released on October 3, 2026, by the Subordinate Services Selection Board, Punjab (PSSSB) for 681 Craft Instructor (ITI Instructor) posts. The written examination is scheduled from October 6 to 13, 2026

item.title: Punjab Courts Clerk Recruitment 2026
item.description: Recruitment for 1270 Clerk positions in the Subordinate Courts of Punjab. Requires a Bachelor's degree, 10th with Punjabi, and computer proficiency. Selection involves a CBT and Computer Proficiency Test

item.title: SAIL CMLO Young Professionals Recruitment 2026
item.description: SAIL CMLO is recruiting 4 Young Professionals (Civil Engineer, Surveyor, IT Engineer, Electronics Engineer). Candidates with B.E/B.Tech or MCA and relevant post-qualification experience, aged 35-42, can apply via email by October 22, 2026. Salary ranges from Rs. 70,000/- to Rs. 1,40,000/- per month

item.title: IBPS Clerk CRP CSA-XVI Recruitment 2026
item.description: IBPS has released a recruitment notification for Customer Service Associate (CSA) / Clerical Cadre positions in various public sector banks. Eligible graduates can apply online for 11663 vacancies. The application period is from August 1, 2026, to August 28, 2026

item.title: Railway RRB Technician Recruitment 2026
item.description: Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) has released CEN No. 02/2026 for Technician Grade-I Signal and Technician Grade-III posts across Zonal Railways and Production Units. A total of 6,557 vacancies are available. Online applications are invited from eligible Indian citizens

item.title: PSSSB Punjab Craft Instructor Recruitment 2026
item.description: PSSSB has reopened applications for 681 Craft Instructor / ITI Instructor posts in the Department of Technical Education and Industrial Training, Govt of Punjab. Eligible candidates with Degree, Diploma, or ITI in relevant trades can apply online. Age limit is 18-37 years

item.title: JKSSB Junior Health Inspector & Technician Admit Card 2026
item.description: Admit cards released for JKSSB Junior Health Inspector (FW) and Technician G-II (Lab Group and Medical Group) posts under Notification No. 07 of 2025. The OMR-based written exam is scheduled for 6 and 7 October 2026. Download hall tickets from jkssb.nic.in

item.title: ITBP Constable GD Sports Quota Recruitment 2026
item.description: ITBPF invites online applications from eligible male and female Indian citizens for 126 vacancies of Constable (General Duty) under Sports Quota 2025. Candidates must be matriculation pass and have represented State/Country in recognized sports competitions. Age limit is 18-23 years

item.title: One Time Registration (OTR) for National Scholarship Portal
item.description: The National Scholarship Portal (NSP) has introduced a One Time Registration (OTR) process to simplify the scholarship application procedure for students across India
